text:
maria: Pushed a small follow-up to the surface API PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4721 — addressed the serialization nit and added a unit test. PTAL when you have a minute.

alex: Quick question — does this change the SDK contract or callers in any way? want to know if we need a migration note.

maria: Nope — signatures unchanged. It's purely internal encoding of the handler payload; added a note in the PR description and changelog entry.

ci-bot: CI status: ✅ unit tests (124/124) | integration (29/29) | build 2026-03-18_14:07 (build/2026.03.18-42)

sam: Looks small. I can eyeball it in ~30m. One request: if it's just the nit+test, please squash before merge.

maria: Sure — happy to squash. If we want to keep the test separate for history I'm fine keeping two commits, but squash on request.

lee: Heads up — there's a canary window on Friday. If this is low risk let's gate on canary + smoke and avoid landing directly to stable today.

maria: Good call. I'll add a "hold-for-canary" label and wait for smoke. PTAL again @alex @sam :thumbsup:

alex: PTAL done — LGTM, nothing blocking from my side.

sam: Quick pass done, LGTM. Please squash into one commit and add a short commit message (e.g. "fix: surface api serialization nit + test"). :white_check_mark:

maria: Squashed and force-pushed: `git reset --soft HEAD~2 && git commit -m "fix: surface api serialization nit + test" && git push --force`. PR now labeled hold-for-canary and comment added. Will merge after smoke passes. Thanks all!
